spiritgiven.comments: positive mindset and smiles all around, cheering us on throughout the game with a 7 man team
they actively avoided contact especially on defense and one of the girls also checked in with our girls during the point
Team Huck had a great positive attitude, and it was nice to see both teams cheering for each other. We appreciate how they checked in on us in between points.

Great positivity from the team! We felt that the hand signals could have been clearer on the brick call, contested fouls and injury substitutions (tapping the ground), but we appreciated how the team was very receptive to feedback.

We felt that there were some inconsistent calls with respect to travel calls, i.e. some players knew that there are no stoppages for travels, but other players seemed to think so.  

In terms of communication, it could be improved for hand signals, as there were often no proactive hand signals. We also felt we had to clarify the specific call (for eg for pick calls) as the players were not communicating effectively.

There was improvement from our previous game! Still some confusing hand signals (for eg signalling retract when it was a contest, not signalling brick calls). We also felt that there was a significant amount of contact that could have been avoided.

Team huck cheered for us for every bid our team made. The positive energy from the team was infectious, which raised out spirit more even when we were down. Team also made effort to high-five us after every point.

spiritreceived.comments: Both teams will work on using hand signals!

Thanks for good game.
It was great to encourage each other during the game

Commendable that good plays from both sides were celebrated, intensity and positivity kept high through the whole game
Fouls: despite letting players know about body contact, there did not seem there was an adjustment 
Communication: receptiveness on discussing calls can be improved - quick to contest without hearing other POV
Improved SOTG from previous game! Love all the smiles :)
